verdict.rationale: Runpod's docs describe templates as pre-configured Docker image setups. They state you can pick an official Runpod PyTorch template instead of installing PyTorch, JupyterLab and dependencies yourself. A community user confirms launching from templates "in a few clicks," and the docs also cover vLLM workers on Serverless. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of ComfyUI and CUDA-specific templates, a documented vLLM Pod template (only Serverless vLLM workers are shown), and a listing of the template catalog's breadth.
